executive_summary: Maven compilation failed due to 45 missing dependency errors. The project requires Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang dependencies that are not declared in pom.xml. All errors stem from missing Maven dependencies that must be added to resolve the build failure.

errors.message: Spring Security packages not found (config.annotation.web.builders, config.annotation.web.configuration, config.http, web)
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class imports Spring Security classes but the spring-boot-starter-security dependency is not declared.

errors.message: Spring Data JPA packages not found (data.jpa.repository, data.domain, data.repository.query)
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces extend JpaRepository and use Spring Data annotations but spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is not declared.

Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity classes use JPA annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column) but jakarta.persistence package is not available. This is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml as it includes Jakarta Persistence API. If already added, verify the Spring Boot version compatibility.

errors.message: Apache Commons Lang3 package not found
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. The ValidationUtils class imports org.apache.commons.lang3 but the commons-lang3 dependency is not declared.
